title: The Bridge of Borrowed Steps
hook: The bridge only lets you cross if you walk in someone else's footsteps.
twist: The last set of footsteps belongs to the person waiting on the other side.
script: They said the bridge only lets you cross in someone else's footsteps. He walked it anyway, one careful step at a time. Halfway across, the footsteps stopped being his. The last pair belonged to the person waiting on the other side.
